notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Physics Engine Rework

Turns out the physics engine had some non-deterministic edge cases, causing desyncs on some machines. So for this patch, I rewrote most of the game's physics code. You shouldn't notice much difference in gameplay.
Added many physics optimizations, to compensate for some slower performance after the rewrite. As a result, you will actually see an increase in performance from the last patch.
Reworked Zomborg's shotgun physics for better performance. It is now a single hitbox that instantly deals damage the frame you use it. It will penetrate targets, and simulates a number of bolts hit. The closer the target is to Zomborg, and the closer to the center of the blast they are, the higher the number of hits. As a result, it is no longer completely useless at mid-range, and the damage falls off more smoothly over the hitbox's range.
Reworked the code that manages Cyber City's laser push mode. This fixes a number of bugs, and increases its performance. (This also fixes the bug with no-centerline matches in this mode).
Increased the stun length of Zandra's whirlwind hits from 100ms to 200ms. This will prevent characters from acting while caught in it and cancelling her ability.
Prevented debuffs like max's poison from damaging Veronica's turret health before damaging the shields.
Since this work has all been on the coding side, we had some art bandwidth to create a new skin for Zomborg:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/fe494c96f49318d4a6772a368d2371497fe3af18.png

notes.notes:

added cursor clip option, set to "fullscreen only" by default. Also has always on/off options. This restricts your cursor to the window, so you can't accidentally unfocus your window by clicking on a second monitor.
possibly fixed a crash on startup caused by the settings file.
added a message for connections timing out, to make it more clear.
reduced the impact of some instant-disconnect bugs. Currently working on a more thorough fix for the next patch.

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.7
notes.notes:
Patch v0.7 is now live, which will be the last patch before the transition to full release on 11/16. In this patch we added the new map, Treetop Terrace!

This map spawns special throwable crystals along with the normal dodgeballs, each having a unique effect. Here's a quick match between devs showcasing the new map:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kotKDPdwW38

The 5 Types of Crystals

Ice
Significantly slows your speed.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/c9f93c0d72c5ff5e041375adaaf7686c5451fd77.gif

Confusion
Reverses your movement and aiming controls.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/0f500141054051b32274ad5b1952c8b78f089583.gif

Lightning
Stuns for a medium amount of time.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/009ffe68e3f554d823ff3ffaa99784e4cb62793a.gif

Concussion
Causes a heavy-hitting explosion.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/e773fbf0b91bac666ddd6fcedd40f96b54d1d5b9.gif

Bramble
Creates a patch of thorny vines on the floor.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/6da2c163852bc88bcae984fa96aa2bd7a60d7b77.gif


One crystal spawns at a time, the next being tossed out after the current one is thrown. Matches on this map revolve around competition for the crystals.

The crystals in Treetop Terrace are thrown out by the rocky natives, who love a good dodgeball match!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/d8cc8d514e47d017a2c9b4cfb5143fa9f812fd88.gif



That sums up our new map, I hope you guys have fun with it! We are going to be working on some polish and marketing next, and the transition from early access to full release will happen on 11/16!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/a5f066e75c0cc14006bb98a39a81d5aec94afc90.gif

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.5
notes.notes:
Content

added new arena: Cyber City! The special mode on this map is a 'tug of war' sort of scenario, where you push the centerline towards the other player's side.  This map is just for local play at the moment, but the next patch (a couple of weeks from now) will allow all maps to be played online, so look forward to that!


Balance

Let Max melee his own bubbles to give them velocity
changed Zandra's ball damage power from .8 to .5
increased Zandra's Whipslash cooldown from 1s to 2s
increased Zandra's Cyberslash cooldown from 1s to 2.5s
increased Zandra's Whirlwind cooldown from 1s to 2.5s


Zandra had a near-infinite combo in her kit, and was honestly destroying everybody else. Hopefully this makes her a little more reasonable.

notes.title: Patch Notes - V0.4.1
notes.notes:
Minor patch tonight, on account of a couple of bugs I found. Also includes a couple of the updates I've made that aren't related to the new map patch.

fixed a bug introduced by the last patch, where a caught ball sometimes couldn't be thrown
fixed a bug where polly's fist could teleport you over boundaries
added secret freelook mode - hold Back(gamepad) or Backspace(keyboard) while unpausing
added small vulnerability window at the end of knockback- about 200ms, or 12 frames (assuming 60fps). This window allows you to hit them before the knockup ends, and before they can react, making knockup a much more useful mechanic.
Turrets are now affected by Max's poison

notes.title: Patch 0.4 - Optimization
notes.notes:
Optimization patch just went live! Not a very content-heavy patch, but I'm sure some will appreciate this:

-assets are now being preloaded, and more projectiles like balls are being recycled in memory, so the game should run noticeably smoother on older machines now.
-balls are now seen traveling when stolen by max, and added a little animation when you pick up a ball:

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579196/fd75add4ff94b16755a9883cf4e1dc60c3ad7235.gif



As a side note, we've met our dev timeline  for our first few patches, but it looks like our next map won't be polished/ready for release by next week, so that date will be pushed back until we are really happy with the map. I also swapped the dates for updates v0.6 and v0.7, since we realized that would make much more sense. Get excited for the content coming soon!

notes.title: Patch 0.3 - Juggerbot mode!
notes.notes:
Patch daaaaay!

Major Changes:

implemented a local multiplayer game mode: Juggerbot mode! Best played as a 4 player FFA timed battle. The player that currently holds the Juggerbot gains ridiculous strength! Team up to kill him!
reworked map select screen to include match options
added option to toggle off hazards/special modes
added option to adjust the number of dodgeballs in a match
added random map button
took out these match options: infinite power, instant cooldowns, and unsafe boundaries. If you want these back then speak up, but as far as I know, no one uses them. Not very fun game options. If you have a good idea for other options I'd like to hear them.
updated textures and lighting on Geode Junction and Mayhem Mechanics
made boundary pulse color and wall hit animation color change with current winner


Minor Changes:

made character info button a little more obnoxious so that new players notice it
made submenus transparent when not active, to make them less confusing
changed all on/off options to use checkboxes
updated spark particles on dodgebot and the arms in mayhem mechanics


Bug Fixes:

fixed fatal error that would occur when you turned off bloom and then changed your window mode
fixed issue with submenus being unselected after alt tabbing out
made music stop immediately when you alt+f4
tutorial text fixes

notes.title: Dev Plan - Tentative Full Release Date of 11/16
notes.notes:
Hi everybody,

Peter and I went through our plans, organized our features, and picked out tentative release dates for our patches. We have a tidy view of them on the website: http:www.pixelvex.com/development

They are ALL subject to change, so don't expect these dates to be exact. Since this is an effort done in our free time, we thought making public development plans with tentative deadlines would be the best way to keep ourselves on track, and keep you in the loop.

Also, these are only the bigger patches that add content. We will be patching bugs and balance issues ASAP as they are discovered in between these patches. Also also wik, the content of the patches is malleable. It can be changed if it turns out everyone hates something in particular, or feels the game is incomplete without a certain feature. So give us some feedback!



Anyway enough disclaimers, here's the rundown:

Update 1: Map Select Rework, 6/29
We're going to do some redesign on the map select screen, so that match options are more visible. This is to make way for the new mach options we will be adding, and the special modes we will be adding.

Update 2: Optimization, 7/20
I haven't done a great job recycling game objects and preloading them, so I'm going to do some work on that to make the game run a little smoother on older machines.

Update 3: New Map, 9/1
Gonna add a new map here, will let you know when we have some prototypes to show


Update 4: Online Update, 9/15
We will be adding some quality of life things for online matches, and allow unranked matches to change all game settings (stock, game mode, the level, etc). This is just for Unofficial matches, so not the ranked queue, just the matches you invite a steam friend to or give out a lobby code for. The Host, or person doing the inviting, will be the one able to adjust settings.

Update 5: Another New Map, 10/6
And another new map. We are thinking a total of 5 maps for the full release right now.

Update 6: Misc Graphics Update / Full Release 11/16
We are always finding small graphics tweaks we want to make. We will be putting any new ones on the backburner until this update, where we will implement a bunch of them at once.
